marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots tonight and Monday. Scattered flurries and fog patches changing to periods of
rain or snow Monday morning then to snow near noon Monday. Visibility 1 mile or
less in fog patches and in precipitation. <br/>

evening.<br/>
